Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was
struck from behind-side while turning left. Complaints centered on low back pain with
muscle spasm and restricted lumbar range of motion. The mechanism of injury is
consistent with the reported force of impact and the pattern of symptoms described at
intake. Examination revealed paraspinal tenderness and reduced flexion, while
neurological screening and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits. No
prior injury or treatment to the lumbar region is known to this provider. Care
consisted of 25 visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home
stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency
reduced over time as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect single
charges for each service date without duplication. At discharge the patient reported
near-resolution of symptoms and was released to independent home exercise with
follow-up as needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
